title: HiL Test Engineer
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Roles & Responsibilities :

- Understand the new concepts of next generation EE architecture

- Understand the body electronics functions requirements related to multiple systems

- Develop test specifications, test scripts and test framework

- Test case execution on dSPACE HIL or Vector platform

- Debug, analyze failures and report to defect management systems

- Discuss with System developer about the observed system behavior for issue resolution

- Collaborate with other system testers to exchange ideas on improving quality of HIL testing

- Follow the approach to bring maximum Test automation from the beginning
Qualifications
Educational qualification:
B.E./B.Tech
Experience :1-3 years
 
Mandatory/requires Skills :

CANoe, VTest studio, CAPL
VT system/ dSPACE HiL
Diagnostics, Network management
Communication Protocols - CAN, LIN
GiT understanding
Domain - BCM
Preferred Skills :

- Graduate/Post Graduate in Electronics/Electrical/Mechatronics/Instrumentation engineering

- Should have good command on any of the body electronics functions. E.g. Wiper system, sunroof, door control, keyless go, locking system, exterior light, interior lights, seat control system etc. (Any of these system)

- Should be able to imagine different testing scenarios and write test cases by understanding the system requirements
- Should be able to Analyze Requirement, Develop - Test Spec, Test Script (PTTA preferably / CAPL / Python / Perl / C / C++), Execution & Defect identification & Logging

- Good experience in UDS based Diagnostic testing, DoIP

- Should have worked on Vector Test benches.
- Should have basic knowledge on setting up HIL environment, loads, hardware connections and flashing ECU.

- Should know basic concepts of Object oriented programming

- Knowledge and experience with Provetech scripting language will be best fit but Python scripting language will also work

- Good understanding of ECU communication protocols like CAN, LIN, Flexray and Ethernet

- Good experience in bringing automation in testing projects

- Should have Good analytical and problem solving skills

- Well-developed communication and teamwork skills

- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Outstanding personal initiative, sense of responsibility, commitment and perseverance

- Eager to learn and work with new technologies
Additional Information

text:
Premium Support Engineer - L3

  This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you.

What you’ll do:
Lead and drive troubleshooting on Customer reported issues.
Isolate Product issue at hardware/software level, replicate customer environments in lab, own and document communication among customers, engineering and provide final fix.
Be a customer advocate for timely resolution of the problems reported, understand the environment/network and impact on business.
Gain in-depth knowledge of the infrastructure and technologies that are present in customer’s network profile; including their network topology, features, configurations, and service history, which results in faster resolution.
Partners internally with other Services teams to deliver focused support by participating in Customer reviews, Network trainings and driving critical issues to resolution.
Keep the other support teams trained on the designated CFTS customer network, practices followed.
Provides technical expertise and guidance during testing, deployment and operational phases for CFTS Customers.
Participate in tasks such as new product development projects, Knowledge base creation, trainings, and other documentation activities.
Mentor newly hired support engineers and peers in technical areas of specialty.
Products to be supported - Switching Platforms (Juniper/Aruba), WLAN Platforms (Juniper/Aruba), Software Platforms (Juniper/Aruba)
Primary Skills required:
Excellent Customer handling and communication (verbal and written) skills 
 
What you need to bring:
Strong understanding of SD-WAN architectures and technologies, including overlays/underlays, application-aware routing, path selection, service chaining, segmentation, WAN optimization, and centralized orchestration platforms.
Working knowledge of SD-WAN deployment and operations, including branch onboarding, tunnel establishment, policy design, high availability, traffic steering, and troubleshooting across hybrid WAN environments.
Good understanding of Layer 3 networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, routing concepts, QoS, NAT, VPN technologies (IPsec/GRE), and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and IS-IS.
Fundamental Layer 2 knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs (802.1Q), LACP, STP/RSTP, ARP, and BFD to support branch, campus, and WAN connectivity troubleshooting.
Experience with SD-WAN security and access services, including segmentation, Zero Trust concepts, secure internet breakout, firewall integration, security policies, and SASE/SSE fundamentals.

title: AI/ML Research Scientist, Edge AI
text:
AI/ML Research Scientist, Edge AI

Description -
Job Summary
• This role is responsible for specializing in development and deployment of machine learning models that drive innovation and business value. The role researches and implements appropriate ML algorithms and tools, runs machine learning tests and experiments, and trains and retrains systems when necessary. The role contributes to building, customizing and deploying models in production edge AI environments and ensuring their seamless integration.

Responsibilities
• Develops and programs integrated software solutions, especially in support of the development, deployment and life cycle of machine learning models.
• Trains and validates models using appropriate evaluation metrics and techniques.
• Optimizes and tunes hyperparameters to improve model performance and generalization.
• Deploys machine learning models to production environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
• Monitors and maintains deployed models, making necessary updates to adapt to changing data or requirements.
• Spearheads the design of ML systems, experiments with ML algorithms, and regularly trains systems for maximum efficiency.
• Designs, develops, tests, and maintains ML pipelines that efficiently produce scalable models.
• Cooperates with CI/CD teams to ensure seamless deployment of models to production.
• Partners with research and engineering teams to enhance automated model training techniques.
• Applies machine learning and statistical modeling techniques to business or research problems.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in computer programming languages, machine learning, algorithms, statistical methods, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.
 
Knowledge & Skills
• Algorithms
• Artificial Intelligence
• C++ (Programming Language)
• Computer Science
• CUDA (kernel programming)
• Deep Learning
• Llama.cpp
• Machine Learning
• Natural Language Processing
• Python (Programming Language)
• PyTorch (Machine Learning Library)
• Scikit-learn (Machine Learning Library)
• Software Engineering
• Triton (Kernel programming)

Cross-Org Skills
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope
• Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

Complexity
• Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.
